0022600222.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-10, on a seven-game losing streak and 15th in the East) host the Los Angeles Lakers (10-2, on a six-game winning streak and 1st in the West). Myles Turner is out for rest, Tyler Herro is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision, and Quentin Grimes is out with a finger injury for the Lakers. The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with the Bucks winning the last meeting 105-101 in Los Angeles on January 9, 2026.
